methods: Construct the smallest exact identity in a newly specified legal operation alphabet.
Derive a target-specific relaxation bound for that same explicit alphabet.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Name the changed hypothesis, all counted roles and a uniform identity; finite column tests alone do not certify it. A scoped local result may be retained without a complete supplier. Expanding it into further construction rounds requires the family-level budget and obligation gate in research-family-status.md; an optimistic passing relaxation alone is not acceptance.

Repeating the two-register GL3 census or a covered three-register length without changing a hypothesis; a formal group-algebra word without native conversion is a partial result.

actual_scope: Derive a mixed-target scalar-span and constructive dirty-register compression bound in the formal abelian rank-one model, with an eight-call three-target application.
scope_change_reason: Take the explicit mixed-target scalar-span handoff in bit-identical-three-targets-dirty rather than construct another finite word. This reduces arbitrary dirty workspace to bounded role domains without repeating covered censuses.
bottleneck_link: A successful eight-call three-target dimension-three kernel could save one of nine direct children. This lemma only bounds its formal scalar search domain; it does not supply a kernel, a native invoice or an exponent improvement.
stop_rule: Stop after the written reduction, constructive exact fixtures and failure controls; no dependent construction expansion or larger word census.
